title: Cleanup passes, cross-model protocols, and people named by role only (2026-11-27)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
I've set codex to continue this work to test how we can do cross model protocols. We've done a few different passes to clean up the data.

The next pass is to clean up the people and bios - we should just simply name a role... don't comment on people.
